notes.title: The 8th District
notes.content:
We're thrilled to present to you The 8th District, a free-to-play minigame based off the world of MimiCries. Inspired by games like The Exit 8 and Shinkansen 0, players encounter a looping series of similar rooms, wherein you will have to correctly guess whether they contain anomalies to clear the game.

notes.title: Actions and Threats
notes.content:
Happy Steam Scream to you fans and fearers of horror (and games that give a good scare) 👻

To commemorate this Halloween, here's presenting two new game mechanics related to a player's perception in the world of MimiCries:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/8f18eb66fb2ad42e0fc79ea2f597f8843b9ffeb1.png[/img]

[b]1. Action Indication[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/cb3d2a485e9911e0aaa6582023c2ef3110537006.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/50815390d3027a2510b7e5d0a8ae36a55b3bbe34.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/1f74e4af88beb1bc48e0297f6803010e3250dfa4.gif[/img]

Whenever the player is near to or facing most objects or points of interest, a floating '[i]eye-con[/i]' will pop up and indicate that it is interactable.

[b]2. Threat Notification[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/f7fd2c0c81f912929d531ecd62bfd55ed9e9d08e.png[/img]
In some areas where a harmful entity lurks in wait for the player, a warning message will display on screen for a short duration.

Both of these new mechanics require the starting of a new game to take effect, so what better than this spooky occasion to try (or re-live) the MimiCries experience?

notes.title: Game Balancing and Player Fortitude
notes.content:
For this update, it is by no chance fortuitous that we're bringing another new mechanic into play: the Fortitude Gauge 💗

After many months of deliberation over game balance, this mechanic is now here to make confrontations with most adversaries more manageable, and functions in the following ways:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/2bd28c64dc4791a32b94b1e8907160b10371e26f.png[/img]The player starts the game with a full fortitude gauge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/36ee2dd2a6d92328e889993fc61991a74bf7025e.png[/img]Taking hits during adversary encounters reduces this gauge by varying amounts. The player may restore their fortitude by using matches from their inventory or interacting with save points.

Additionally, we have also added more clues to one of the more challenging puzzles found in the "Gambling Hall". We hope players who were previously stuck will find these clues helpful 🤝

notes.title: Controller Support has been added
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying MimiCries so far!

As part of this update, we have included basic controller support into the game for players who prefer using controllers. 

Below are the default key bindings, which you may find in the options menu:

Keyboard & Mouse ⌨️
← ↑ ↓ → : Movement
Z: Confirm
X: Cancel/Menu
Shift: Sprint
Q: Special

Controller 🎮
D-Pad/Left Joystick: Movement
A: Confirm
B: Cancel 
Start: Menu
RT: Sprint
LT: Special

notes.title: MimiCries Alternative Ending Route Released!
notes.content:
What an ominous date for an update... 👻

To start things off, we've fixed 2 achievements which some of our players have had difficulties unlocking, namely the "Avid Reader" and the "Incurred Demise". 

Kindly take note that if you are experiencing audio issues in the background after loading a save file, it has been rectified. However, due to game engine limitations, you may need to save the game elsewhere, and then re-launch MimiCries, and resume from the new save file.

For players who have supported us since early access, if you have a save file since that time, do bear in mind that some things may not be working as intended, so it is recommend to start a New Game (new cutscenes and gameplay sequences have been added for you to experience).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/f299efa5845185b14da3f41e035778314b0828f3.png[/img]

Now onto the update you've been looking forward to... A tragic end may befall the player in the new ending for MimiCries, but there are certain conditions players must meet in order to unlock this route. 

Here's a small hint to start you off: [i]fate is as fickle as the face of a flipping coin[/i] 🎭

Get in touch with us via our [url=https://miniversalgames.carrd.co/]Socials[/url], or Email us directly at Miniversal.games@gmail.com


We are also working on a Discord Community Server for players to gather and get updates in real-time. Stay tuned for more information🎙️

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes and Changes #03
notes.content:
We're glad to see that some of you who have tried our game have liked it!

We've taken note of some of the feedback and bugs that were faced while playing MimiCries and have pushed out fixes for it. Check the Changelog section to see a more detailed list of fixes.

Changelog for 02/28/2024 update:
- Added flavor text interaction point in Lord Griswald's Bedchamber
- Changed a line of flavor text during a sequence that occurs in the Bedroom of the Daughter
- Enhanced the visibility of a textual clue that is found in the Bedroom of the Daughter
- Fixed a pop up image not disappearing after its interaction in the Dinner Banquet Room
- Fixed a bug in The Lord's Study whereby a sound persists after Game Over and requires the game to be restarted.

Upcoming Changes:
- We have enabled 1 achievement icon which is visible but not working. We're doing our best to implement all the achievements and ensure that it is working before making them live. 

Thank you for your continued support and patience.

Get in touch with us via our Socials, or Email us directly at Miniversal.games@gmail.com

notes.title: MimiCries First Release has been confirmed!
notes.content:
We've come a long way since the beginning of development on MimiCries since the start of 2023, and we're quite excited to inform all of you that we've finally hit a major milestone...

The launch version of MimiCries will be releasing a week from now, on the 14th of February 2024! 

As part of the launch release, you may look forward to:
- A total of five different puzzle rooms throughout the game
- A new addition of a path which leads to a game clear sequence

We've also opted to refine our graphics in multiple areas in our game, notably, the title screen and the game over screen visuals.

But don't think this upcoming update will be the last from us, we will have more in store!

notes.title: Game Updates for Friday the 13th!
notes.content:
Seeing that Friday the 13th falls on spooky month this year, we’ve decided to release a new puzzle as part of the continuation of the MimiCries storyline. 

We’ve also added some quality of life changes to the game;
- Hints collected throughout the game will be displayed in the inventory
- Some rooms that were previously locked are now accessible at the start of the game 
- Additional atmospheric lighting effects

We have also updated the game with some additional comfort changes, slightly more hints included in areas where it was difficult to determine clues, such as in the first puzzle, where there is a guide to help check if you've explored the area properly.

1 new puzzle stage has been released, which extends the playtime by about an hour, including a new character and their lore associated with them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/bc003441aee61d0c793c5e3f4d165774653d2f65.gif[/img]

notes.title: MimiCries October Update!
notes.content:
Hi, 

It’s been awhile. 
We have a couple of updates for MimiCries.

[b]Early Access Updates for October[/b]

On [u]Friday the 13th[/u], we’ll be releasing a new puzzle as part of the continuation of the MimiCries storyline. 

Also, we’re adding some quality of life changes to the game;
- Hints collected throughout the game will be displayed in the inventory
- Some rooms that were previously locked are now accessible at the start of the game 
- Additional lighting effects

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44595139/395588de2010598ad1546540fe00b07a5419feed.png[/img]

[b]Participation in Steam Scream [/b]

We are excited to announce that we have been invited to join the Steam Scream sales happening from October 27th to November 3rd. 

MimiCries will be on a [i]30% discount[/i] during this period. 

Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist!

[b]Release date update[/b]

Last but not least, we would like to announce that the full game will be released some time in Mid-December 2023. For those who have purchased the early access, your version of the game will automatically be updated to the full version upon release.

Cheers!
